brand.feature1Desc: Proven dermatological actives with clear mechanisms and balanced concentrations
brand.feature2Desc: Every formula is designed for hot, humid climates and real-life conditions
brand.feature3Desc: Clear-origin ingredients and rigorously tested formulas for long-term use
brand.feature4Desc: No animal testing at any stage — lab-tested and human-volunteer tested
brand.aboutText: ORIA is more than just a name — it represents the natural rhythm of the skin. From the belief that skin doesn't need to become something else but needs to return to its best self, ORIA was created as a space for recalibration. We combine proven dermatological actives with a deep understanding of skin behavior in hot, humid climates to create products that are safe, effective, and suitable for long-term use.
brand.collectionsSubtitle: Three focused systems with a cleaner structure, helping you pick the right routine quickly without visual clutter.

brand.highlightDesc: Intensive dark spot correcting serum powered by 5% Tranexamic Acid, 2% Alpha Arbutin, and 5% Niacinamide. Helps reduce dark spots, post-acne marks, and uneven skin tone.

blog.title: Skincare Insights
blog.subtitle: Tips and guides from the ORIA team
blog.post1Title: A Complete & Effective Acne Skincare Routine at Home
blog.post1Excerpt: Acne-prone skin doesn't need more intensity — it needs the right care, done consistently and patiently. Here are simple tips to help you care for acne-prone skin in a more gentle and sustainable way.
blog.post2Title: Exfoliation – The Key to Smoother Skin, Fewer Breakouts, and Better Absorption
blog.post2Excerpt: Exfoliation is one of the most essential yet often misunderstood steps in skincare. When done incorrectly, it can make skin more sensitive. Learn how to exfoliate correctly and effectively.
blog.post3Title: Bright, Healthy Skin Starts Within: Vitamin C by Day & Retinol by Night
blog.post3Excerpt: There is one simple yet highly effective skincare principle: protect during the day, repair at night. Learn how to combine Vitamin C and Retinol for brighter, firmer, more even-toned skin.
